about_the_game:
Slendrina: Escape Together is a cooperative horror game where players must solve captivating puzzles to progress through levels while escaping from the sinister ghost Slendrina. Band together, think quickly, and act in unison to avoid the fate that lurks around every corner.

Immerse yourself in a tense and chilling atmosphere where every mission demands speed, ingenuity, and teamwork. As you advance, you’ll encounter dangerous traps and hidden secrets, as well as collect important items—from mysterious liquids that help restore your sanity to various artifacts that unveil the dark past of the cursed Slendrina.

Key Features:

• Online co-op for up to 4 players
• Thrilling puzzles that require collaborative solving
• A dark, tense atmosphere of true horror

Band together, think quickly, and act in unison to overcome every challenge and avoid the fate that awaits at every turn.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 - 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 470 with 4GB VRAM ／ NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 with 4GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
